script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: THE AWAKENING

INT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

A bustling corporate environment, employees scurry about, working diligently at their desks. MARK, 35, a mid-level manager, sits at his desk, staring at a computer screen, frustration etched into every feature of his face.

MARK
(whispering to himself)
This isn't what I signed up for...

Suddenly, his computer monitor flickers, the screen going black. Confused, Mark looks around, but no one else seems to notice. He leans in to touch the screen, and as he does, it jolts him with a strange energy.

INT. MARK'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Mark lies on his bed, staring at the ceiling, his mind racing. He can't shake the feeling that something has changed.

MARK
(to himself)
What the hell was that?

The next day, as Mark walks through the office building, he notices that everything seems different. Colors are more vivid, sounds are more pronounced, and people appear more alive. He soon realizes that he can hear others' thoughts – a phenomenon known as "the Awakening."

INT. MARK'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - DAY

Mark sits on the couch, contemplating his newfound abilities. He's filled with a mix of excitement, fear, and confusion.

MARK
(talking to himself)
I have to figure out how to control this...

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Mark spends hours at the library, researching the Awakening. He learns that it's a rare occurrence, and that those who experience it often go through a period of adjustment.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Mark meets up with an old friend, JENNY, 32, a former colleague who left the corporate world to become a painter. She listens intently as Mark explains his situation.

JENNY
So, you're hearing people's thoughts. That's intense.

MARK
I know. It's overwhelming at times, but I think I can use it to my advantage.

JENNY
(smiling)
You always were good at finding the silver lining.

INT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

Mark returns to the office building, determined to use his abilities to make a difference. He listens in on coworkers, learning about their struggles and concerns. Armed with this knowledge, he begins to make small changes to improve their work environment.

INT. OFFICE BUILDING - MEETING ROOM - DAY

Mark calls for a staff meeting, proposing a new project that he believes will boost morale and productivity. His colleagues are hesitant at first, but Mark's passion and understanding of their needs wins them over.

INT. PARK - DAY

Mark sits on a park bench, basking in the sunshine and the peacefulness of the park. He's no longer frustrated with his career – instead, he's found a new purpose.

MARK
(talking to himself)
This is the real me...

Fade to black.

THE END
